findings.title: Port is already in use
findings.cause: container metrics exits because port 8080 is already in use: container web of the same pod also listens on 8080, and containers in a pod share one network; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container metrics exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container metrics's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail: httpd: bind: Address already in use

evidence.what: containers metrics and web both declare port 8080
evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-64496df69d-d5w8n -n kd-port-in-use -o jsonpath='{range .spec.containers[*]}{.name}{" "}{.ports}{"\n"}{end}'

findings.fix: Give metrics or web another port (and update the Service's targetPort to match).
